reason: R3 M1 motion correspondence and paired-statistics gaps remain after nine matched controls; no formal TEST prediction/task score has been read
training_change: NONE: nine modes/seeds/budgets/init/selection unchanged; no retraining

counterfactual.transform_choice: fixed for all source images/severities/seeds before TEST effects; do not search rotations for damage
counterfactual.physical_construction: Reintegrate transformed four body-rate intervals using the existing SO(3) convention; recompute dense forward trajectories and timed quadratic C/E at identical K, exposure/fit times/quadrature/map_scale, then the same full-canvas common crop. Do not merely rotate 2D displacement vectors. No blur resynthesis.
not_preserved_or_claimed: descriptor correspondence to the unchanged blurred image
counterfactual.checkpoint: same best full_maps checkpoint as the correct branch for each seed; do not select a new checkpoint
counterfactual.threshold: Reuse the frozen correct full_maps normal-valid threshold for the corresponding class/strength/seed; no new mismatch calibration
counterfactual.coverage: all802 sources times3levels times3full-model seeds; no quality-based exclusion
counterfactual.descriptor_validity: validate recomputed fit finite/valid over complete frozen ROI before inference; any invalid case records incomplete scope, never substitute correct maps or silently drop sources
counterfactual.metrics: same restoration/image-ranking/originalROI pixel/coverage/clip definitions as main study; correct-minus-mismatched paired comparison, no required direction

statistics.resampling_unit: original source image as cluster; keep its three severities and all three seed predictions together
statistics.strata: four PCB categories x original binary image label, preserving each stratum source count
statistics.point_aggregation: For each category/severity/seed compute paired source effects; average seeds and give equal weight to4categories and3severities. Report all three seed point effects/range separately.

primary_endpoints.metric: mean per-source linear MSE reduction = zero_MSE - full_MSE; positive favors full
image AUROC_full - image AUROC_zero, recomputed with the same resampled source multiplicities for each branch

statistics.multiplicity: two co-primary endpoints use Bonferroni alpha=.05/2 each; no unadjusted significance claim over all exploratory contrasts
statistics.secondary: full vsendpoint, correct-full vsRz90-mismatched, image AP, and severity-specific effects: 95% exploratory percentile intervals, clearly labeled; no forced benefit or selective seed reporting
statistics.perfect_restoration: MSE primary remains finite even at zero error; PSNR perfect flags/null remain descriptive, no hidden epsilon
statistics.pixel_metrics: per-class/severity/mode/seed and macro descriptive; do not bootstrap pixels as independent observations
statistics.interpretation_limit: benchmark source-image resampling conditional on the three trained seeds and fixed class/label prevalence; physical board/session independence and population training-seed uncertainty are not established
statistics.failure_or_null_effect: retain all fixed seeds/strengths, no must-win stop or sign-driven protocol change
statistics.task_metric_aggregation: Recompute AUROC/AP within each category x severity x seed from unchanged original labels/scores using sampled source multiplicities, then average seeds and macro categories/severities; never average nonexistent per-image AUCs.
statistics.source_order: strata sorted by category then original binary label; source IDs lexicographic within each stratum; draw with replacement from each stratum in that order per replicate
statistics.claim_rule: Restoration and task endpoints support their own conclusions; any joint supported-benefit claim must be assessed against both co-primary endpoints. Null/reversed effects and exploratory status remain visible.

base_result_coverage: main sharp/blur/nine restoration branches remain separately auditable; addendum outcomes cannot be called part of an already completed study

independent_review.scope: design gaps only; execution and outcomes unverified, no scientific Accept
